notes: Draft full racing circuit through Bane 1 and the outer Bane 2 loop, identified from the venue facilities description and marshal-post map and checked on independently georeferenced licensed imagery. Coordinates and order use exact pinned OSM ways 102145330 version 18 and 338068128 version 2, with shared junction node IDs 1178910200 and 1178910082. Replaces only the generic longest-cycle training/pit detours. No diagram coordinates, stated width or nominal distance is fitted. Fine alignment and travel direction remain provisional. Public timing remains missing.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.
Produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union, EU-DEM layers.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 50 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Sparse road-edge controls reviewed on nine native-image cross-section sheets, three wide detail sheets and the complete southern road image. Road-colour proposals are authoring diagnostics only: paint, shadows, aprons, vehicles and branch openings are corrected against visible road edges. Positive source normals point to the inner ring and negative to the outer ring. Source trace and direction are retained. Shared-pavement openings use explicitly estimated joins between adjoining observed edge positions; these virtual controls are not independent physical edge measurements. Intervals between controls remain interpolated estimates. The pit-side straight and straight sections at source stations 288–321, 387–423 and 663–705 use separate observed endpoint lines for the two road limits; intermediate fitted controls are not independent image observations. No nominal width or stated length is fitted. Borders remain unverified; curbs illustrative, terrain elevations estimated and banking unknown. Curved sections use smooth interpolating fits through selected visible curb positions at source-station ranges 225–300, 366–396, 429–477, 492–540 and 591–630; the 768–15 seam uses a provisional smooth join through the adjoining observations. These fits replace rejected angular colour proposals. Dense samples of the fits are reconstruction controls, not additional image observations.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed from complete pairs of sparse image-edge measurements. Each pair defines its own road section; the original trace is preserved and constrains station displacement and route order. Linear intervals, junction openings and curbs remain estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. No automatic evidence scores are claimed.
